subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the existing effective at-most-one same-session `ContextEngine.maintain()` behavior after timeout, or formally adopt a cancellable/re-entrant plugin contract?
rationale: The proposed timeout improves liveness but shifts concurrency responsibility onto installed plugins; choosing serialization versus a new SDK cancellation contract is a durable compatibility decision, not a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Preserve same-session serialization
options.body: Keep a core-owned invocation tail or coalescing barrier so timing out the lane can unblock user work without starting another plugin maintenance call until the earlier call settles.

options.title: Adopt a cancellable SDK contract
options.body: Add a reviewed, additive abort/cancellation contract with migration guidance and compatibility tests before allowing a replacement same-session maintenance call.

recommendation.title: Preserve same-session serialization
recommendation.body: Keep a core-owned invocation tail or coalescing barrier so timing out the lane can unblock user work without starting another plugin maintenance call until the earlier call settles.
